title: Rye Delight Sandwich
description: A classic combination of flavors and textures in a simple sandwich.
instructions: 1. Preheat a pan over medium heat.
2. Place the slices of rye bread in the pan.
3. Cook for 2-3 minutes on the first side, or until the bread is toasted.
4. Flip the bread and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
6. Assemble the sandwich by placing the halal delight on one slice of toasted rye bread.
7. Place the other slice of toasted rye bread on top of the halal delight.
8. Cut the sandwich in half and serve.
